# FLX-3509: a sink target carries user information, a query or a fragment

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A sink target that is a URL names a place and nothing else. User information (s3://user:pass@bucket/), a query string (?sig=...) and a fragment can each hold a credential, and a target is written into the receipt and the logs, so the target is refused before the sink is opened. The message shows the target with them removed. Pass the place alone and give the credentials through the environment or the platform's own credential chain. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

$ fluxsim explain FLX-3509
